title: Session-open surface structure
question: While we check your session, which opening structure should Tamagn use? The roll assigned the timed three-act title sequence.

options.label: Three-act verification title
options.lineage: Timed full-bleed acts inside Tamagn’s ink · gold · parchment world
options.thesis: Opening the app plays three short acts — Trust, Prove, Certify — then lands on Dashboard or Login.
options.viewport: Full-bleed parchment: Act 1 brand seal blooms; Act 2 inputs (screenshot · QR · ID · SMS) stamp in; Act 3 certificate foil settles while session resolves.
options.risk: If acts run longer than a fast session fetch, the exit must cut early — never force the user to wait on choreography.

options.label: Cut-paper title cards
options.lineage: Saul Bass title sequence grammar fused with Tamagn materials
options.thesis: Staccato full-bleed cards: one silhouette idea per card — receipt, QR beam, gold seal — on swapping ink/parchment fields.
options.case: Stronger motion craft; must keep Tamagn palette or it loses Ethiopian verification trust.
options.viewport: Card cuts: ink field + receipt cutout → parchment + QR beam → green field + foil seal + brand name.
options.risk: Reads cinematic but can feel less ‘official document’ than seal/certificate language.

options.label: Official seal stamp
options.lineage: Single ceremony: foil seal stamps while product line holds
options.thesis: One composition — logo as seal, gold ring stamps, one sentence about trusted Ethiopian receipt checking.
options.case: Clearest product clarity and brand continuity; quieter than a title sequence.
options.viewport: Centered seal on parchment; ring animates closed; brand + subtitle; soft progress arc.
options.risk: Safer; may feel closer to a branded spinner than an ‘opening’ experience.

canonCard.label: Category standard splash
canonCard.thesis: Logo, short tagline, indeterminate progress — executed with full Tamagn craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centered logo, subtitle, gold progress bar on parchment.
